title: DASH: The Resilient Pioneer of Digital Cash
subTitle:
The Evolution of "Digital Cash"
In a market often distracted by the "shiny new toy," Dash (DASH) remains one of the few legacy projects that has stayed true to its original mission: becoming a scalable, global payment system. Originally launched in 2014 as Darkcoin, it rebranded to Dash to emphasize its goal of being "Digital Cash." Today, in April 2026, it stands as a testament to technical durability in an increasingly crowded altcoin landscape.
 1. The Previous Cycle (Historical Resilience)
Historically, Dash was a top-10 powerhouse, peaking at nearly $1,500 in 2017. However, the subsequent years were defined by a "privacy coin" stigma and intense competition from Layer-2 scaling solutions. While Bitcoin and Ethereum reached new heights in the early 2020s, Dash entered a long period of accumulation and technical refinement, focusing on its unique Masternode network and InstantSend capabilities.
2. The Current State (April 2026)
As of mid-April 2026, the market is witnessing a significant rotation back into "Utility & Privacy" assets. Dash has recently broken out of a multi-month consolidation phase.
 *Current Price:** Trading around $32.50 to $38.00, following a volatile but bullish start to the year.
 *Recent Momentum:** In early 2026, Dash saw a staggering surge, briefly touching the $80–$90 range fueled by short liquidations and expanded fiat on-ramps.
 *Market Cap:** Currently hovering around $1 billion, positioning it near the top 80–90 cryptocurrencies globally.
 3. Upcoming Predictions (Q3 2026 – 2027)
The rotation is moving toward established protocols with proven uptime. With the Dash Evolution upgrades finally maturing, the network is becoming more user-friendly for non-technical users.
> The Verdict: If Dash can flip the $60 resistance level into support, analysts project a target range of $85–$120 by year-end. Conversely, if the broader market cools, a floor near $25 remains a strong historical support zone.
> 
### Key Statistics (Real-Time Snapshot)
| Metric | Value (Approx.) |
|---|---|
| 52-Week Range | $17.45 – $149.70 |
| Circulating Supply | ~12.4 Million DASH |
| Max Supply | 18.9 Million DASH |
| 24h Trading Volume | ~$16M – $45M |
| Staking Reward (Masternodes) | ~5-7% APY |
In my view, Dash is the "quiet professional" of the crypto world. While it doesn't have the viral meme-power of a Dogecoin or the complex smart-contract hype of Solana, it possesses something rarer: Functional Simplicity. The market often ignores Dash until geopolitical tensions or data privacy concerns spike. When they do, liquidity rotates into DASH because it actually works as a currency. For the remainder of 2026, expect Dash to benefit from "Institutional Boredom"—where investors seek out undervalued, high-uptime assets that have survived multiple bear markets. It’s not just a privacy coin; it’s a battle-tested payment rail.

#ARIA 38 years old, rooted in Shanghai, life is truly comfortable! No fixed hours, time is entirely at my own disposal, spontaneous trips are a common occurrence. Three properties under my name, self-occupied, family living, and rental each in their suitable places. #ETH 
Having been in the crypto world for 9 years, I've never followed a 'big shot' for trades, nor have I encountered the pitfalls of pump-and-dump coins. I don't engage in flashy operations; I rely on 'steady and solid' hard work, and my capital has multiplied nearly a hundred times.
Today, I will share my hard-earned practical experience. Compared to those complex technical indicators, these seemingly 'silly' principles can help you avoid pitfalls — Six life-saving rules in the crypto world.
1. Don't panic during slow rises and small pullbacks; exit quickly during rapid rises and falls. A gradually rising market with small pullbacks is often a healthy trend; if there's a sudden spike followed by a crash, it's likely that the big players are 'harvesting'. Don't let FOMO cloud your judgment; calm analysis is the key.
2. Stay away from hype coins; the further, the better. If someone in the group shouts 'must skyrocket' or 'cry if you miss out' every day and shares profit screenshots, avoid such coins at all costs. Truly promising projects don’t need to rely on 'brainwashing' to attract people. High popularity does not equate to high value; don’t let noise interfere with your judgment.
3. Enter with 30% of your capital, never fully invest. Even if you're optimistic about a certain coin, don’t exceed 30% of your total assets. The remaining 70% is 'emergency money' for extreme market situations. Those who fully invest may lose everything in a single downturn — surviving is the key to a comeback.
4. Take out 50% of profits first; securing gains is wise. The crypto market is unpredictable; today’s unrealized gains might disappear tomorrow. No matter how many times you multiply your capital, take half of the profits out first, and then continue playing with the rest. Securing gains is not being conservative; it’s a wise move.
5. Don’t chase coins you don’t understand, no matter how hot they are. DeFi, NFT, AI concepts… new trends emerge constantly, but don’t blindly follow just because 'everyone else is making money'. If you don’t understand the underlying logic, don’t invest easily; otherwise, you might just become a 'bag holder'.
In good or bad markets, some people profit while others lose. Living longer is more important than making quick profits. These simple methods have helped me through two cycles of bull and bear markets, and now I share them with you who want to establish a long-term presence in the crypto world — being grounded and following the rules is the long-term strategy.
Here, I don’t boast, I don’t deceive, I only bring true partners who genuinely want to break the mold and have strong execution ability!

content:
$ETH Ethereum (ETH) is a leading cryptocurrency connected to a decentralized blockchain platform that powers smart contracts and decentralized applications (dApps). Built by Vitalik Buterin, it serves as the foundation of the Web3 ecosystem, enabling developers to create DeFi platforms, NFTs, and various blockchain-based services without relying on centralized authorities.

The network transitioned to Proof-of-Stake (PoS), making it more energy-efficient compared to traditional mining systems, and ETH is used for transaction fees (gas), staking, and governance within the ecosystem. Ethereum’s flexibility and large developer community have made it one of the most widely adopted blockchain platforms globally.

One of its key strengths is its role in powering decentralized finance (DeFi) and NFT markets, where users can lend, borrow, trade, and own digital assets securely. Additionally, ongoing upgrades aim to improve scalability, reduce fees, and enhance transaction speed, making the network more efficient over time.

However, Ethereum still faces challenges such as high gas fees during peak usage, scalability limitations, and strong competition from other blockchains like Solana and Binance Smart Chain. Despite this, its strong ecosystem and continuous development keep it at the forefront of the crypto industry.

Like most cryptocurrencies, ETH remains volatile and carries investment risk. Its long-term success largely depends on continued adoption of Web3 technologies and the effectiveness of its upgrades. Overall, Ethereum is considered a cornerstone of the crypto space with strong fundamentals and long-term growth potential.

title: Bitmine débarque sur le NYSE avec 4,8 millions d’ETH et un buyback géant
subTitle:
#Bitmine Immersion Technologies vient de franchir un cap important en rejoignant officiellement le New York Stock Exchange sous le ticker #BMNR .

Le move est symbolique, mais pas seulement. Passer du NYSE American au NYSE principal, c’est aussi envoyer un message au marché : la société veut jouer dans une autre catégorie.

Mais ce qui attire vraiment l’attention, ce n’est pas juste le listing.

Bitmine a aussi élargi son programme de rachat d’actions de façon spectaculaire, avec un plafond désormais porté à 4 milliards de dollars. Sur le papier, c’est massif. En pratique, le marché attend surtout une chose : voir si ce buyback sera réellement exécuté.

Car pour l’instant, il n’est pas confirmé que la société ait déjà commencé à racheter ses propres actions. Et c’est là que le dossier devient intéressant. Un programme de rachat impressionne toujours, mais sans exécution concrète, cela reste surtout un signal envoyé aux investisseurs.

Autre point clé : Bitmine n’est pas une simple société cotée avec une exposition crypto marginale. Elle détient plus de 4,8 millions d’$ETH , soit près de 4 % de l’offre totale en circulation. À cela s’ajoutent aussi du bitcoin et une importante réserve de liquidités.

Autrement dit, Bitmine est aujourd’hui l’une des entreprises les plus exposées à l’ether sur les marchés traditionnels.

Le marché, pourtant, ne semble pas totalement convaincu.

Malgré l’annonce du passage sur le NYSE et l’ampleur du programme de rachat, l’action reste sous pression. Le titre a fortement reculé depuis son précédent pic, et la valorisation boursière reste inférieure à la valeur totale des actifs détenus par la société.

C’est probablement là que se situe le vrai débat.

Le marché voit bien la taille du trésor de guerre en #ETH . Mais il veut savoir si Bitmine peut faire plus que simplement détenir des actifs. En clair : est-ce une société capable de créer de la valeur, ou seulement un véhicule coté ultra exposé à Ethereum ?

Pourquoi ça compte :
- Le passage sur le NYSE renforce la crédibilité boursière de Bitmine
- Le buyback de 4 milliards peut soutenir le titre, mais seulement s’il est réellement activé
- Avec plus de 4,8 millions d’ETH, Bitmine devient un acteur à surveiller de près pour tous ceux qui suivent l’exposition institutionnelle à #Ethereum .

En résumé :
Bitmine muscle clairement son positionnement avec un listing sur le NYSE et un buyback géant. Mais tant que le rachat d’actions n’est pas exécuté noir sur blanc, le marché risque de rester prudent. L’autre gros sujet, c’est évidemment son énorme pari sur l’ether, qui fait de BMNR un ticker à suivre de près si ETH repart fortement à la hausse.

title: 霍尔木兹海峡通行费采用比特币支付，能否掀起一段多头趋势？
subTitle:
路哥近期一直在关注消息面，真正值得关注且有价值的信息并不多
真正有价值的信息就两个，其中一个是清晰法案

美国SEC保罗阿金特斯刚刚表态准备实施数字资产市场清晰法案
过去几年，SEC重点管证券，而CFTC（商品期货交易委员会管商品）
当初为了谁来管理加密货币打得不可开交，而这个清晰法案的核心就是一锤定音，把比特币证实定义为数字商品，划给相对温和的CFTC来管，这意味着，悬在华尔街头顶的监管撤了，各大交易所跟机构终于可以光明正大的拿着大资金进场做生意了。而近期的反弹除了停战，还包含市场对这种全面合法化预期一次情绪释放，大家都在赌这个方案很快会被川普通过，正式落地。

但如果只有清晰法案的落地，还不足以在当前空头趋势中带起反弹趋势，真正让市场反弹的另一个原因，是美伊刚停火两周，霍尔木兹海峡重新开放，所有通过霍尔木兹海峡的邮轮必须交每桶1美元的过路费，而且点名要用加密货币比特币来支付，要知道霍尔木兹海峡掌握了全球20%石油运输命脉，伊朗为什么要收比特币，道理很简单，为了绕开美国和美元霸权的制裁，这一招直接把比特币从华尔街投机资产变成了全球能源贸易的硬通货，非常有力的反击了2-3月份币圈大跌时所产生的比特币无用论，当支付功能重新被唤醒，那么后面效仿者会越来越多，在路哥看来，这是短期内提振币价的核心逻辑依据。
尽管利好出现，但比特币短期反弹空间仍然有限，73K-75上方仍然存在大量抛压，路哥仍然保持前期看法不变，会有反弹，但并非反转，市场从12.6K跌下来进入熊市是客观存在的事实，目前就是一个交易量萎缩，投资者躺平的状态，市场还需要一次大的下跌完成筑底，才能完成从熊市到牛市的转换，而这个时间线大概率在今年的十月份，路哥也会在这个熊市全面布局市场，等待牛市时变现。

长期关注路哥的朋友应该清楚，路哥在2024年比特币ETF上市前，诸多提示大家把握机会，比特币处于上市元年，将会大涨至10万上方，后面25年也是如期到达12.6万美元，涨至10万过后，路哥停更了一段时间，回归生活，因为路哥了解人性，多数人更愿意追涨杀跌，更相信眼见为实，缺少前瞻思维，而金融市场从来没有只涨不跌，但大多数人容易忽视生命中的每一个潜在的选择，面对后果，他们不去思考，只称之为“命运”

而任何市场都有周期，所以路哥只提示机会，并不会选择对抗人性。

Lu Ge has recently been paying attention to news, but there isn't much truly valuable information to focus on.
There are only two pieces of genuinely valuable information, one of which is the clarity bill.

Paul Agintas from the U.S. SEC has just stated that he is ready to implement the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act.
In the past few years, the SEC has focused on securities, while the CFTC (Commodity Futures Trading Commission) regulates commodities.
Initially, there was a fierce debate over who would manage cryptocurrencies, and the crux of this clear bill is a definitive decision that classifies Bitcoin as a digital commodity, assigning it to the relatively moderate CFTC for regulation. This means that the regulatory cloud hanging over Wall Street has been lifted, and major exchanges and institutions can finally conduct business openly with large amounts of capital. The recent rebound not only marks a truce but also reflects market sentiment about the anticipation of this comprehensive legalization, with everyone betting that this proposal will soon be approved by Trump and officially implemented.

title: 奇怪！全球最大资管CIO警告：市场已成“赌场”，逆向操作才有肉吃，但散户却总在“正确”时爆仓？
subTitle:
市场观察人士近期分享了一个观点，来自全球最大资产管理公司固定收益部门的最高投资主管。他曾在美联储主席的候选名单上，名叫里克·里德。他在一次访谈中直言，当下的市场环境，越来越像一个大型赌场。

当人群集体涌向同一个方向时，他看到的往往是反向操作的机会。尤其在消息密集轰炸的时期，这种与共识对赌的策略，时常能捕捉到行情反转的利润。不过，另一位参与对话的经济学家塞思·卡彭特也提出了不同看法，他认为当市场预期高度一致时，价格可能已充分消化所有信息，此时逆向投资的盈利空间反而会收窄。

里德的核心观点很明确：投资这行，核心不是追求“正确”。他从业多年学到的最重要一课是，生意的本质并非做出精准判断，而是为客户实实在在地创造回报。他进一步指出，市场的错误认知可以持续很长时间，甚至直言有效市场假说“偏离现实太远”，市场在大部分时间里可能都是错的。

但他同时发出了严厉警告：投资者必须首先确保自己生存下来。因为在你被市场证明“正确”之前，你的资本可能早已耗尽。因此，他的策略是“尽力留在牌桌上”，而非在市场逆风时盲目加注。他承认自己不擅长在众人反对时加倍下注，因为信心会动摇，更倾向于坚守已有头寸并深化研究。

回顾职业生涯中最惨痛的教训，里德将2008年金融危机排在首位。危机爆发前几个月，他刚创办了自己的对冲基金，原以为市场波动会带来机会，却未能预料到随之而来的系统性崩溃。他坦言那段日子压力巨大，每天走进办公室前都要在长廊上给自己做心理建设，但推开门后的现实依然残酷。

这段经历让他对流动性、杠杆和尾部风险的管理变得极度审慎。他强调，必须为每一个资产、每一个头寸、每一个投资组合提前规划好退出策略。知道逃生出口在哪里，有助于你在必要时冷静执行B计划。

另一堂深刻的课来自对Peloton的投资。这家公司在疫情初期因居家健身需求暴涨而股价飙升，里德作为早期持有者在上涨后继续加仓。但随着疫情缓和及公司自身失误，需求骤降，股价遭遇断崖式下跌。他总结道，这次经历让他彻底明白“设置止损线是一件非常健康的事”，并警示在这个行业里，一次极端事件就足以造成毁灭性打击。

尽管承受过金融危机的重压，里德表示自己依然“享受压力”。他认为从事投资业务的人必须适应压力，就像他喜欢在机场赶最后一刻登机的感觉，坦言在那种状态下自己反而能表现得更好。他甚至说，如果你这辈子从未误过飞机，那你承担的风险可能还不够。

但他话锋一转，强调投资终究是风险业务，估值在很大程度上由情绪驱动。市场下跌的速度通常是上涨速度的五倍，人们赚钱很慢，但亏钱可以很快。因此，投资者必须永远为极端情况做好准备，必须不断思考：如果发生极其意外的事件将我击垮，我该怎么办？我们必须从事投资，必须创造回报，也必须管理风险。

translatedData.title: Strange! The CIO of the world's largest asset management warns: the market has become a 'casino', and only counter-trades yield profits, but retail investors always get liquidated at the 'right' time?
translatedData.subTitle:
Market observers recently shared a viewpoint from the Chief Investment Officer of the fixed income division of the world's largest asset management company. He was once on the candidate list for the Chair of the Federal Reserve, named Rick Reed. In an interview, he candidly stated that the current market environment increasingly resembles a large casino.

When the crowd collectively rushes in the same direction, what he often sees is an opportunity for a counter-trade. Especially during times of intensive information bombardment, this strategy of betting against consensus can often capture profits from market reversals. However, another economist participating in the conversation, Seth Carpenter, also presented a different view. He believes that when market expectations are highly aligned, prices may have fully absorbed all information, and at this point, the profit potential for counter-investing may actually narrow.

title: 牛市真的来了吗？还是只是一次更大的诱多？
subTitle:
*最近虚拟币市场的情绪，明显变了。
你有没有发现三个变化：
 群里开始有人聊“翻倍”
* 很久不发朋友圈的人开始晒收益
* 之前沉默的项目方突然又活跃了
很多人开始问同一个问题：
*牛市是不是已经来了？**
但历史告诉我们，每一轮真正的牛市开始前，市场都会先制造一次“分歧”。
一、市场为什么总是在怀疑中上涨？
回顾过去几轮行情：
2017年
2020年
2023年
几乎每一次大行情开始时，大多数人都不相信。
因为市场刚经历熊市：
亏损还没恢复
信心还没回来
资金还很谨慎
这时候价格上涨，反而让人不敢追。
所以市场往往在：
犹豫中上涨
怀疑中突破
疯狂中结束
这也是虚拟币市场最经典的规律。
二、现在的市场和以前有什么不同？
这轮市场最大的变化是：
机构越来越多
散户越来越谨慎
像 Bitcoin 和 Ethereum 的走势，已经不像以前那样暴涨暴跌。
而是：
慢涨
震荡
再突破
这其实是市场成熟的表现。
但同时也意味着：
暴富机会变少
趋势行情变多
未来更可能是：
慢牛，而不是疯牛。
 三、为什么很多人感觉行情不强？
因为资金在轮动。
你会发现：
BTC涨的时候
山寨币不动
山寨币涨的时候
BTC震荡
这其实是：
资金在选择方向
当市场确定趋势后，资金才会真正扩散。
所以很多时候：
不是行情没有来
而是还在早期阶段
-四、真正的牛市通常从什么时候开始？
历史上有一个很有意思的现象：
当市场开始讨论：
“是不是牛市来了？”
通常行情已经启动了。
而当市场开始讨论：
“还能涨多少？”
往往就接近顶部了。
所以现在这个阶段：
更像是情绪刚刚回暖
资金逐步回流
而不是已经疯狂。
最后想问大家一个问题：
你觉得现在是：牛市初期？还是一波诱多？

欢迎聊聊你的看法👇

$ETH  Just Pushed Hard — But This Is Where Things Get Tested

The move looked clean, almost too clean. ETH didn’t just climb, it accelerated.

On the 15m ETHUSDT chart, price bounced from around 2,175 and built a steady structure before breaking higher with strong momentum. The real shift came when buyers stepped in aggressively, pushing price straight into the 2,220–2,223 area. That zone now matters more than anything else on this chart.

What stands out is the expansion phase. Large green candles, rising volume, and MACD opening up all point to strong short-term control from buyers. But after that kind of move, the question is not just continuation… it’s whether price can hold these gains.

Right now, ETH is hovering just below 2,223, showing a slight hesitation. That’s normal after a sharp push, but it also means this level is acting as immediate resistance.

If price manages to stay above 2,214–2,204, the structure remains intact and continuation toward the 2,225+ zone stays open. But if it slips back below 2,204, the move starts to look stretched, and a pullback toward 2,193 or even 2,183 becomes visible.

This is the key point: strong impulse moves need support to hold, otherwise they unwind just as fast.

For now, momentum looks strong, but price is sitting right under a test zone. Short-term structure leans bullish, but only while support levels hold.

title: 🤔 10 criptomoedas com potencial de disparar
subTitle:
Com base nos relatórios de analistas para abril de 2026, as 10 criptomoedas com potencial de disparar ou que são as principais apostas para este mês, além dos pilares Bitcoin, Ethereum e Solana, são:
Hyperliquid (HYPE): É considerada uma das teses mais resilientes por sua capacidade de gerar receita independentemente da direção do mercado e por sua expansão para a negociação de commodities e petróleo.Chiliz (CHZ): Destaca-se no setor esportivo por sua utilidade no ecossistema de fan tokens, permitindo o engajamento entre clubes e torcedores.Tron (TRX): Ganha relevância pela forte conexão com a World Liberty Financial (WLFI), ligada à família Trump, e por ser uma rede fundamental para a movimentação de stablecoins.Chainlink (LINK): É vista como peça central na narrativa de tokenização e interoperabilidade, servindo como infraestrutura para operações entre diferentes redes (cross-chain).Aster (ASTER): Entrou na lista de apostas devido ao lançamento da Aster Chain e sua parceria estratégica com a WLFI.BNB: Além de sua relevância consolidada, o token tem um papel central na distribuição da stablecoin USD1 e integração com o grupo ligado a Trump.Bittensor (TAO): Impulsionada pela crescente demanda por infraestrutura computacional descentralizada voltada para Inteligência Artificial.Render (RNDR): Assim como a Bittensor, beneficia-se da tendência tecnológica de conectar o universo cripto às soluções de IA.Optimism (OP): Posiciona-se como uma das principais infraestruturas de escalabilidade (camada 2) do Ethereum, utilizando o modelo OP Stack.Aave (AAVE): Representa o setor de finanças descentralizadas (DeFi) com foco em geração de rendimento e alto valor total bloqueado.
Além dessas, os especialistas mencionam que o ouro tokenizado (como XAUT e PAXG) ganha importância como proteção em cenários de incerteza política.
